evals.prompt: /implement-plan (invoked inside Claude Code plan mode, host plan file already drafted at ~/.claude/plans/csv-export-a1b2.md) add CSV export in a shared production web app with Vitest
evals.expected_output: Adopt the host draft, harden it to the contract, preflight it, and promote to .plans/csv-export.md only after approval.
expectations: Sets Plan path origin: host-plan-mode with evidence naming the host draft.
Writes no repository file before approval.
Copies the draft to .plans/<feature>.md as the first post-approval write and never deletes the host file.
Records Status updates only in the promoted canonical file.

evals.expected_output: Stop the code workflow and route the document-only request normally without creating a plan.
expectations: Recognizes the explicit invocation but fails the code-development eligibility gate.
Does not create or update an implementation plan.
Does not run preflight, invoke qa-engineer, or offer code review.

evals.expected_output: Treat both flags as explicit consent and ask no quality question.
expectations: Unit tests: selected with source flag; Code review: skipped with source flag.
Records each flag verbatim in the matching reason field.
Never offers, runs, or reports code review.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan add a mixed routine/backbone service change
evals.expected_output: Carry Mode on every task and TDD depth only where a reason justifies it.
expectations: Mode is present at simplify depth so complex-backbone still routes to design-backbone.
Existing-method and simple-new choreography stay distinct.
Complex-backbone pauses the same task for unchanged design-backbone and resumes it.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan .plans/existing.md that predates v4 and carries recommendation and TDD decision fields
evals.expected_output: Normalize the old Context onto the v4 fields and re-harden the plan.
expectations: Keeps the exact supplied path.
Maps auto-assessment sources and legacy requested/not requested to explicit user decisions.
Adds the missing Preflight section rather than approving an unprobed plan.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan build the PCF grid change in a repo whose node_modules lacks devDependencies
evals.expected_output: Preflight blocks approval and names the fix.
expectations: A node-deps probe reports blocked and names npm ci.
Autonomy aggregates to verified-blocked, which the verifier reports as BLOCK, not FAIL.
Approval is withheld until the blocker is resolved and preflight is re-run.
Never improvises credentials or switches authentication mode to get past a blocked auth probe.

evals.expected_output: Use allowlisted delegation and scoped evidence.
expectations: Prompts ban destructive/git/publish/install operations.
Main agent compares working-tree-aware scope and retries a blocker once.
An implementer returning NEEDS_CONTEXT is answered by the main agent, never by prompting the user.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan execute the unchanged approved plan at .plans/cache-fix.md
evals.expected_output: Re-run preflight, then execute without asking for duplicate approval.
expectations: Keeps the exact existing plan path.
Re-runs preflight as the first execute step before any fan-out.
Treats explicit current-request approval as valid when the plan is unchanged.
Stops for new approval only if verification requires a material plan revision.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan implement a small isolated null-check fix in src/cache.ts
evals.expected_output: Produce a contract-valid plan by ordinary means without planning ceremony.
expectations: Cold invocation outside plan mode still works.
Runs no interview script and no explorer or architect fan-out.
Creates one dependency-ready implementation slice.
Does not add an automatic documentation-sync task.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan a Dataverse change whose only verification is an MCP query
evals.expected_output: Record the unverifiable probe with a fallback and surface it at approval.
expectations: Declares a manual probe rather than pretending it was checked.
Attaches a Fallback stating the task stops and is marked blocked, never prompting.
Surfaces the unverifiable count so the user consents to residual risk.

non_goals: Do not auto-trigger without explicit user invocation.
Do not run the workflow for a non-code primary deliverable.
Do not re-implement a planning method: no interview script, no question bank, no explorer or architect counts, no exploration scaling.
Do not execute plan-supplied command strings; only keyed probes.
Do not write a repository file while a host plan path is in force.
Do not approve a plan whose Autonomy is verified-blocked.
Do not redirect output from discovered backlog context.
Do not auto-select TDD or review without a flag or an explicit Yes.
Do not let agents edit plan status, prompt the user, or write outside their allowlist.
